Use the provided RIVEN — TWO YEARS LATER, RIVEN'S ISOLATED FOREST CABIN, and WOODEN TRAINING SWORD references.

Keep Riven's exact face, pale-blonde hair, body proportions, clothing, and overall appearance consistent with the RIVEN — TWO YEARS LATER reference.

Keep the isolated cabin, outdoor clearing, surrounding mountain forest, terrain, vegetation, and overall atmosphere consistent with the cabin environment reference.

The wooden training sword must remain the same large, broad, two-handed wooden practice sword shown in its reference.

=== TECHNICAL ===

16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Grounded photorealistic realism.

Cold early morning in an isolated mountain forest.

Soft overcast natural light.

Thin mist drifting between the trees.

Natural human movement.

Realistic two-handed sword practice.

Restrained cinematic camera movement.

Natural cinematic cuts.

No dialogue.

No subtitles.

No background music.

Use only natural sound:

cold mountain wind,
moving grass,
distant birds,
forest ambience,
Riven's distant training shouts,
her breathing,
footsteps on dirt,
and the wooden training sword moving through the air.

The overall atmosphere is quiet, lonely, reflective, and slightly melancholic.

The first part of the scene should establish that Riven still remembers the two people she lost.

Then gradually reveal the solitary life she now lives.

=== VIDEO SUMMARY ===

Two years have passed.

Begin near Riven's isolated cabin with a simple memorial.

Two old swords are planted vertically into the earth beside each other.

They represent the two people Riven lost:

her father,
and the young soldier who became like a brother to her.

Keep the memorial simple and grounded.

After briefly showing the two swords, move through several quick views of the cold mountain wilderness.

Riven is still unseen.

Then her distant training shout echoes through the forest.

The sound of a large wooden practice sword follows.

The camera gradually moves toward the sound.

Through the trees, reveal the isolated cabin.

Beside it, Riven is training alone with her large wooden practice sword.

Her movements are controlled, experienced, and disciplined.

This is her normal morning routine after two years of isolation.

=== SCENES ===

Shot 1 — THE MEMORIAL

Begin very close to the cold earth.

Wet grass moves gently in the morning wind.

Thin mist passes slowly across the ground.

The camera slowly rises.

Reveal two old swords planted vertically into the earth beside each other.

The swords form a simple handmade memorial.

One represents Riven's father.

The other represents the young soldier who became her close companion.

Keep the design understated.

These are two different swords belonging to two different people.

They are NOT Riven's Broken Sword.

They are NOT wooden training swords.

They are old personal swords left here as memorial markers.

A small weathered strip of cloth is tied around one sword.

A different simple military cloth strip is tied around the other.

Both have been exposed to the mountain weather for some time.

There are no large gravestones.

No elaborate cemetery.

No modern objects.

No written text is necessary.

Only the two swords standing quietly beside each other.

The forest and pale morning mist fill the background.

No person is visible.

Only the sound of wind.

Hold briefly.

Then—

from somewhere far away in the forest:

"HAH!"

A distant training shout.

Silence again.

Then faintly:

WHOOSH.

The sound of a large wooden practice sword moving through the air.

Another distant:

"HAH!"

CUT.

=== Shot 2 — THE MOUNTAINS ===

Cut to a brief wide cinematic view of the remote mountain wilderness.

Forest-covered slopes disappear into pale morning mist.

Clouds hang low around the mountains.

No houses or people are immediately visible.

Riven's training sounds continue faintly somewhere in the distance.

WHOOSH.

A short training shout echoes softly through the valley.

CUT.

=== Shot 3 — FOLLOW THE SOUND ===

Move into the forest.

The camera travels naturally between tall tree trunks.

Morning mist hangs low between them.

The training sounds gradually become clearer.

Riven's breathing can now occasionally be heard.

WHOOSH.

"HAH!"

Footsteps moving across dirt.

Another controlled movement of the wooden sword.

The camera continues toward the sound.

Through gaps between the trees, the isolated cabin gradually becomes visible.

Beside the cabin is the small outdoor training clearing.

At first, only a distant moving figure can be seen.

Continue closer.

The figure becomes recognizable as Riven.

CUT.

=== Shot 4 — RIVEN ===

Reveal Riven clearly for the first time.

Use a cinematic medium-wide composition.

She is alone in the training clearing beside the cabin.

Riven holds the large wooden training sword with both hands.

She settles naturally into her stance.

Then she begins another familiar practice sequence.

A strong diagonal swing.

WHOOSH.

A short natural training shout:

"HAH!"

She controls the momentum.

Her feet reposition naturally across the earth.

She turns with the large wooden sword.

Then performs another broad two-handed practice swing.

The sword should feel large and substantial.

Riven uses her legs, hips, shoulders, and both hands together to guide its weight.

Her movements are clean and experienced.

She has clearly repeated this routine many times.

=== Shot 5 — THE ROUTINE ===

Continue with a short, readable training sequence.

Keep the choreography simple.

Riven changes stance.

A controlled swing.

A natural turn.

Another two-handed practice movement.

A precise stop.

Then she resets again.

Occasionally move closer to show small details:

her boots moving across the worn training ground,

both hands firmly controlling the wooden grip,

the broad wooden blade passing through the cold morning air,

loose strands of pale-blonde hair moving around her face,

and her calm focused expression.

Her breathing remains controlled.

The training is serious and disciplined, but not unusually intense yet.

This is simply the routine she follows every morning.

=== Shot 6 — ALONE ===

Gradually move away from Riven.

Transition into a wider composition.

Riven continues practicing.

WHOOSH.

"HAH!"

The isolated cabin stands behind her.

Beyond the cabin are only trees, mist, and mountains.

There are no other people around her.

Slowly pull farther back.

Riven becomes smaller within the landscape.

Her training continues while the camera moves away.

Her footsteps, breathing, wooden sword movements, and occasional training shouts echo softly through the otherwise quiet forest.

End with Riven still training alone beside the cabin.

CUT.、16:9

in the Ally Soldier reference.

The provided battle final-frame reference establishes the current situation:

Riven and Ally Soldier are already fighting together inside a large
circle of SOLDIERS on the mountain road.

Use this image only to understand the current situation and continuity.

Do not recreate its exact camera composition or exact soldier positions.

The HOME/VILLAGE reference represents Riven's home far away
along the mountain valley.

Do not move the action into the village.


=== TECHNICAL ===

16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Late sunset.

Grounded cinematic sword combat.

Natural physical movement.

Natural English dialogue and lip sync.

Natural cinematic cuts and camera movement.

Keep every action simple, sequential, and visually readable.

Do not create unnecessary camera cuts.

All ordinary SOLDIERS belong to the same army.

Riven and Ally Soldier are their only targets.

SOLDIERS never attack other SOLDIERS.

Riven and Ally Soldier never attack each other.

Riven is already physically exhausted from prolonged fighting.

The sacrifice must happen as a sudden last-second reaction.

The essential action order is:

THE ARCHER FIRES.
THE ARROW IS ALREADY FLYING TOWARD RIVEN.
ONLY THEN DOES ALLY NOTICE IT.
ALLY SHOUTS "RIVEN!"
THE ARROW CONTINUES TOWARD RIVEN.
ALLY THROWS HIS OWN BODY INTO ITS PATH.
THE ARROW HITS ALLY INSTEAD.

No graphic gore.

No subtitles.

No background music.


=== VIDEO SUMMARY ===

Riven and Ally Soldier are fighting together while surrounded
by SOLDIERS on the mountain road.

Riven is exhausted from the prolonged battle.

During the fight, a distant archer finds a clear opening toward Riven.

The archer fires.

The arrow is already flying rapidly toward Riven
when Ally suddenly notices it.

Ally realizes Riven does not see the danger.

He shouts her name.

The arrow continues directly toward Riven.

At the last possible moment, Ally throws his entire body
into the arrow's path.

The arrow strikes Ally instead.

Riven catches him as he collapses.

Ally dies in Riven's arms.

While grieving over him, Riven notices enormous columns of dark smoke
rising far across the valley from the direction of her home village.

She realizes that something terrible is happening there.

But Riven does not immediately leave Ally.

Still devastated, she looks back down at him.

She slowly and carefully lowers his body onto the ground.

End on Riven remaining beside Ally.


=== SCENES ===

Shot 1 — FIGHTING TOGETHER

Begin with a closer medium combat angle.

Do not recreate the exact wide composition shown in the provided
battle final-frame reference.

Riven and Ally Soldier are already fighting together inside
the surrounding army.

Keep many SOLDIERS visible around them.

Every SOLDIER attack is directed toward Riven or Ally.

The SOLDIERS never attack each other.

Riven and Ally protect each other's blind sides.

Riven is visibly exhausted.

Her breathing is heavy.

Her movements remain skilled but are becoming slower.

Ally stays close to her while they continue fighting.

Keep this combat section brief and simple.

Its only purpose is to establish that Riven and Ally
are still fighting together.


Shot 2 — THE ARROW AND THE SACRIFICE

During the fighting, a distant SOLDIER with a military bow
finds a clear opening toward Riven.

Riven is occupied fighting another SOLDIER.

Ally is also occupied nearby.

Neither Riven nor Ally notices the archer.

The archer raises the bow.

He aims directly at Riven.

He releases the bowstring.


The arrow leaves the bow and flies rapidly toward Riven.

Clearly establish that the arrow has ALREADY BEEN FIRED.

It is already traveling through the battlefield toward Riven.

Riven does not see it.


Only now does Ally notice the flying arrow.

This is the first moment Ally becomes aware of the danger.

Ally sees the arrow already moving through the air.

He immediately realizes where it is going.

Riven is directly in its path.


Ally urgently shouts:

"RIVEN!"


Riven hears him and begins to react.

But the arrow is already too close.

The arrow continues directly toward Riven.


Ally reacts instantly.

He does not try to block the arrow with his weapon.

He does not push Riven away.

He does not calmly move in front of her.


Ally throws his entire body toward Riven.

He desperately launches himself directly across
the path of the already-flying arrow.


The visual action must remain extremely simple and clear:

The arrow is flying toward Riven.

Ally sees it.

Ally shouts her name.

The arrow keeps flying toward Riven.

Ally throws his own body into its path.


At the final possible moment,
Ally's body crosses directly between the arrow and Riven.


The arrow strikes Ally instead of Riven.


The impact is sudden.

Riven remains unharmed directly behind him.

Ally loses his strength immediately.

Riven catches him before he falls completely.


Shot 3 — ALLY'S LAST MOMENT

Stay close to Riven and Ally.

Do not introduce unnecessary camera changes.

Riven supports Ally in her arms as they lower toward the ground.

The surrounding battle becomes visually secondary.

Riven looks at Ally in shock.

She realizes that he deliberately took the arrow meant for her.


Riven quietly asks:

"Why?"


Ally is badly weakened.

He looks at her.

He answers softly:

"You would've done the same."


A brief silence.

Ally loses his remaining strength.

His body becomes still.

Riven realizes he is gone.


Riven continues holding him.

She does not immediately move.

Her expression is devastated.

Allow a quiet emotional moment between them.


Shot 4 — THE DISTANT FIRE

While Riven is still holding Ally,
something far across the valley catches her attention.

Riven slowly raises her head.

Her attention shifts toward the distant horizon.


Follow her gaze toward the mountain valley.

Far away, in the direction of her home village,
several enormous columns of thick dark smoke rise high
into the late-sunset sky.

A distant orange fire glow is visible beneath the smoke.

The smoke clearly comes from the direction of Riven's home.

Keep everything very far away.

Do not move into the village.

Do not reveal detailed destruction.

Only establish the distant smoke and fire.


Return the emotional focus to Riven.

She stares toward the smoke.

Her grief is joined by sudden fear and realization.

She understands that something terrible is happening
at her home village.


But Riven does NOT run away yet.

She does NOT immediately stand up.

She does NOT leave Ally.


After looking toward the distant smoke,
Riven slowly lowers her gaze back toward Ally in her arms.

The urgency of the distant fire remains,
but for this moment she cannot bring herself to leave him.


Riven looks at Ally's face again.

Her expression remains deeply grief-stricken.

She holds him for one final quiet moment.


Then Riven slowly and carefully lowers Ally's body
onto the ground.

She supports his head and shoulders as she lays him down gently.

The movement is slow and respectful.

Riven remains kneeling beside him.


End with Riven beside Ally's body,
still devastated by his death,
with the distant smoke from her home visible beyond the battlefield.

She has not left yet.

CUT.

Ally Soldier notices her reaction.

Do not show childhood Riven.

allied soldiers behind them,

She realizes what she is looking at.

Riven becomes still.

He looks toward her.

"Riven?"

She answers quietly.

"That's my home."

=== CHARACTER LOCK — STRICT ===

RIVEN:
Use the provided Riven reference image as the strict primary character reference.

Preserve Riven's exact facial identity, facial structure, pale-blonde hair, hairstyle, body proportions, clothing and armor design, sword design, overall silhouette, and grounded warrior appearance.

Riven must remain unmistakably the same character throughout the entire video.

This scene takes place during a catastrophic battle after Riven has already become an experienced warrior.

Her original character design must remain unchanged, but she is now physically exhausted and battle-worn.

Add only temporary battle-state details naturally caused by the current fight: dust and ash on her skin and clothing, messy hair, subtle scratches, minor damage to clothing and armor, and restrained traces of blood on her face.

Do not redesign her costume.
Do not change her hairstyle.
Do not change her body proportions.
Do not replace or redesign her sword.

Riven's physical performance should communicate that she is highly trained but currently exhausted, injured, confused, and emotionally overwhelmed.

Her movement must remain grounded and human.

No dialogue from adult Riven in this scene.

=== TECHNICAL ===

High-end live-action cinematic realistic dark fantasy.

16:9 cinematic widescreen.

Feature-film quality.

Realistic human anatomy.
Natural human movement.
Grounded physical interaction.
Realistic sword weight and metal physics.
Realistic cloth and hair physics.

Maintain strict facial identity, costume consistency, sword consistency, and body proportions throughout the whole video.

The environment is a poor medieval-fantasy village being destroyed during a battle at night.

Wooden houses are burning.
Thick smoke moves through the streets.
Ash and glowing embers drift through the air.
Firelight creates warm orange illumination through otherwise dark blue-gray smoke.

The battlefield should feel chaotic in the distance but visually controlled around Riven.

Do not clearly reveal who is attacking the village.

Enemy soldiers may exist only as indistinct silhouettes, shadows, distant movement, or partially obscured figures.

Do not clearly show military insignia, recognizable uniforms, faces, banners, or faction symbols.

The audience must NOT yet understand who attacked Riven or why the village is burning.

Natural cinematic camera movement.

Use restrained handheld movement during moments of physical struggle, but keep Riven clearly readable.

Avoid excessive cuts.
Avoid rapid montage.
Avoid exaggerated slow motion.
Avoid supernatural movement.
Avoid flashy magical effects.

No subtitles.
No captions.
No visible text during the scene.
No watermark.
No logo.

Audio:
roaring fire,
burning wood cracking,
distant screams,
distant metal impacts,
heavy footsteps,
wind moving through smoke,
falling debris,
Riven's exhausted breathing,
realistic sword impacts.

No background music during most of the sequence.

Allow the soundscape to become increasingly muted near the end before the child's remembered voice is heard.

=== GLOBAL ACTION ===

Open the film in the middle of an unexplained catastrophe.

Riven is already on the ground in a burning village.

The audience receives no explanation of what happened before this moment.

Her sword lies just beyond her reach.

Riven struggles across the dirt and reaches for it.

Despite her exhaustion, she refuses to remain down.

She grabs the sword and forces herself back onto her feet.

Through smoke and fire, an unidentified attacker approaches.

Never clearly reveal the attacker's identity.

Riven barely has enough time to raise her sword defensively.

A powerful weapon strike crashes against her blade.

The impact violently fractures the sword.

A large piece of the broken blade spins away and falls onto the ground.

Riven is thrown backward by the force and collapses again.

She looks toward something happening deeper inside the burning village.

Do NOT reveal what she sees.

Her expression changes from physical pain to shock and emotional devastation.

The chaotic battlefield audio gradually becomes distant and muffled.

Over the image, we hear the remembered voice of CHILD RIVEN asking her father:

"Father... are warriors the strongest people?"

The voice should sound like a genuine memory: a young girl around ten to twelve years old, soft, curious, innocent, natural, and emotionally neutral.

Do not show child Riven yet.

End on the broken sword lying in the dirt as firelight reflects across the fractured metal.

The audience should leave the opening with three unanswered questions:

What happened to the village?
Who is fighting Riven?
Why did her sword break?

=== SCENES ===

Shot 1 — THE REACH

Extreme low-angle close-up almost at ground level.

Riven's sword lies in the dirt in the foreground.

Ash and glowing embers fall around it.

In the blurred middle ground, Riven lies several feet away after having been knocked down.

The burning village fills the distant background.

Riven breathes heavily.

She plants one hand into the dirt and reaches toward the sword with the other.

Her fingertips initially fail to reach the handle.

She drags herself slightly forward.

Keep the camera low and intimate.

Do not reveal any attacker.

Hold enough time for the audience to register Riven's exhaustion.

CUT.


Shot 2 — SHE STILL GETS UP

Close-up on Riven's hand finally wrapping firmly around the sword handle.

She pulls the weapon toward herself.

Transition naturally into a medium shot as Riven uses the sword and one leg to push herself upright.

Her movement is difficult and physically believable.

She briefly loses balance but refuses to fall.

Behind her, wooden buildings burn through thick smoke.

Riven finally stands.

She is exhausted, breathing heavily, but still gripping the sword.

Do not make the pose heroic.

She is surviving, not posing.

CUT.


Shot 3 — SOMETHING APPROACHES

Medium close-up on Riven.

A heavy metallic footstep or weapon sound is heard somewhere through the smoke ahead of her.

Riven slowly raises her eyes.

Her expression becomes alert.

Camera moves slightly behind Riven's shoulder.

Through dense smoke and firelight, show only the vague silhouette of an approaching human figure.

The figure must remain visually anonymous.

No readable face.
No readable armor design.
No insignia.
No faction information.

Riven tightens her grip on the sword.

Another step.

The silhouette suddenly accelerates toward her.

CUT.


Shot 4 — THE BREAK

Dynamic medium shot.

The unidentified attacker enters only partially into frame and delivers one extremely powerful weapon strike.

Keep the attacker obscured by framing, smoke, motion, and backlighting.

Riven instinctively raises her sword with both hands to block.

CLANG.

The weapons collide with heavy physical force.

For a brief instant, Riven holds the strike.

Then:

CRACK.

A visible fracture travels through Riven's blade.

The upper section of the sword snaps away.

The broken metal fragment rotates through the air.

Use a very brief cinematic slowdown only for the broken blade fragment.

Firelight reflects across the spinning metal.

Immediately return to normal speed.

The impact throws Riven backward.

CUT.


Shot 5 — WHAT DOES SHE SEE?

Riven hits the ground hard.

The remaining broken sword slips partly from her hand.

Camera moves into a close-up on Riven.

She initially reacts to physical pain.

Then she hears something from deeper inside the village.

Her eyes move toward the sound.

Her expression changes.

Pain becomes disbelief.

Disbelief becomes quiet devastation.

Do NOT reveal what she sees.

Do not cut to her point of view.

Hold entirely on Riven's reaction.

The surrounding sounds of battle slowly become distant and muffled.

Fire remains visible behind her.

Then, over the image, CHILD RIVEN'S remembered voice is heard softly:

"Father... are warriors the strongest people?"

Adult Riven remains completely silent.

CUT.


Shot 6 — THE BROKEN SWORD

Extreme close-up.

The broken section of Riven's sword falls into the dirt.

CLANG.

The metal settles.

Small embers land around it.

Fire from the burning village reflects across the fractured edge.

Riven is visible only as a heavily blurred figure in the distant background.

Hold on the broken sword.

Almost all battlefield sound disappears.

Only distant fire remains.

Do not reveal the attacker.

Do not reveal what happened to the village.

End on the broken blade.

CUT TO BLACK.

=== END STATE FOR CONTINUITY ===

The opening ends with the broken section of Riven's sword lying in the dirt.

Riven remains alive but emotionally devastated somewhere behind it.

The identity of the attacker remains completely unknown.

The reason the village is burning remains unknown.

The audience has heard Child Riven's voice for the first time but has not yet seen her.

After this video, the film transitions into Chapter 1, many years earlier.

The next scene begins in the same village while it is still peaceful.

Young Riven lives there with her father.

A visual transition may connect the broken sword from the cold open with an intact old sword in her father's home.

=== MOOD ===

The opening should feel tragic, mysterious, intimate, and restrained rather than like a conventional action opening.

Riven is clearly a capable warrior, but the scene deliberately begins at a moment when strength is no longer enough.

Do not explain the conflict.

Do not glorify the battle.

Do not reveal the tragedy yet.

The broken sword is the central visual symbol.

The emotional progression should be:

confusion
→ physical struggle
→ determination to stand
→ unseen threat
→ violent impact
→ sword breaking
→ shock
→ childhood memory
→ mystery.

The audience should immediately want to understand how the young girl they are about to meet eventually becomes the broken warrior shown here.

burning wood cracking,
distant screams,
distant metal impacts,
heavy footsteps,
wind moving through smoke,
falling debris,
Riven's exhausted breathing,
realistic sword impacts.

Open the film in the middle of an unexplained catastrophe.

Riven is already on the ground in a burning village.

The audience receives no explanation of what happened before this moment.

Her sword lies just beyond her reach.

Riven struggles across the dirt and reaches for it.

Despite her exhaustion, she refuses to remain down.

She grabs the sword and forces herself back onto her feet.

Through smoke and fire, an unidentified attacker approaches.

Never clearly reveal the attacker's identity.

Riven barely has enough time to raise her sword defensively.

A powerful weapon strike crashes against her blade.

The impact violently fractures the sword.

The remaining broken sword slips partly from her hand.

Her eyes move toward the sound.

Pain becomes disbelief.

The broken section of Riven's sword falls into the dirt.

Do not reveal the attacker.

Do not reveal what happened to the village.

confusion

→ violent impact
→ sword breaking
→ shock

→ mystery.

Feature-film quality.

burning wood cracking,
distant screams,
distant metal impacts,

wind moving through smoke,
falling debris,

realistic sword impacts.

Open the film in the middle of an unexplained catastrophe.

Keep the attacker obscured by framing, smoke, motion, and backlighting.

CLANG.

Fire from the burning village reflects across the fractured edge.

Hold on the broken sword.

Almost all battlefield sound disappears.

Only distant fire remains.

Do not reveal the attacker.

Do not reveal what happened to the village.

While Yasuo continues running, smoothly move the camera from the rear tracking position toward his side.

He senses danger behind him.

No magical trail.

No energy effects.

He does NOT draw the sword yet.

Hold this image.
